description: This file defines the SecurityValidations class, which extends financial validation methods to include specific security-related validation functions such as issue date, security period, and redemption value validation.

classes.name: SecurityValidations
classes.description: Provides validation methods for securities such as issue date validation, security period validation, and redemption value validation.

methods.name: validateIssueDate
methods.description: Validates the issue date, returning a float representation.

methods.name: validateSecurityPeriod
methods.description: Validates that the settlement date is before the maturity date.

methods.name: validateRedemption
methods.description: Validates the redemption value, ensuring it is a positive float.
